title.narrative: YRS civil society organisations within environment in Serbia
YRS civilsamhällesorganisationer inom miljösektorn i Serbien

description.narrative:
Organisationen Young Researchers of Serbia (YRS) har till Sida inkommit med en ansökan om finansiering med 16 miljoner kronor för att utföra programmet för Serbien "ECO SYSTEM Environmental Reforms Supporting Programme" under perioden 2019-2022. Insatsen syftar till att stärka det civila samhällets organisationers möjlighet att ta aktiv del i Serbiens EU närmande.
Det övergripande målet med programmet är att skydda naturresurser, försvara människors miljörättigheter, samt främja och institutionalisera förbättrat miljöskydd och stärka Serbiens EU reformer särskilt inom Kapitel 27.
Insatsen kommer att bidra till en effektiv operationalisering av resultatstrategin avseende Strategi Resultat R8 under strategiperioden och de kommande åren därefter.
Programmets totala budget är 16 miljoner kronor, varav organisationens egen insats är noll kronor. Det finns inga andra givare för programmet. Programmet kommer att vidareförmedla ungefär 7 miljoner kronor till lokala civilsamhällesorganisationer i Serbien.

The organisation Young Researchers of Serbia have requested from Sida finansing of 16 million SEK for their planned programme in Serbia 2019-2022. The contribution aims to strengthen civil society in order for it to be able to take a more active role in Serbia's EU integration process.
The goal of the programme is to protect the natural resources, defend people's environmental rights, promote and institutionalise improved environmental protection and other issues related EU reforms, and in particular with regard to Serbia's Chapter 27 process.
The contribution is expected to contribute to an efficient operationalisation of the Results Strategy in the startegy period, and specifically its Result 8.
The intervention total budget is 16 million SEK, out of which the organisation’s own funding is zero SEK.
Approximately 7 million SEK of the intervention budget will be forwarded to local civil society organisations in Serbia.

This intervention aims to generate domestic force that will safeguard the space for further development and democratisation, by supporting civil society in their efforts for environmental protection, environmental human rights and advocacy and promotion of the primary importance for Serbias EU integrations. Civil society development will also work to enhance the adequate civic response in addressing gaps between citizens and governments, thus restoring the public confidence and trust in institutions. By raising awareness of civil society partners democratisation efforts, this intervention will aim to help improve the general level of trust towards the civil society sector as generator of democratic development and will raise citizens awareness of benefits of democratization and EU integration process specifically related to environmental awareness and reforms related to EU Chapter 27.

title.narrative: Young Researchers of Serbia, support to environmental CSOs Agreement
Young Researchers of Serbia, support to environmental CSOs Decision

description.narrative:
Networking of stakeholders and capacity building activities were in focus of the ECO SYSTEM programme in 2023:
- Development of Environmental Protection Strategy of the Republic of Serbia started in January 2023 with active participation of YRS and implementing partners. Some 90 civil society representatives collaborated in national working group for development of this important strategy, and significantly influenced its development by sending over 500 comments and suggestions. One result is that those inputs initiated addition of new chapter on horizontal legislation in the strategy, giving suggestions for financial framework for biodiversity etc. This is a good example of a transparent decision making process that enabled civil society organisations to actively participate. This is important for strengthening dialogue and cooperation with the environmental institutions.
- The tenth Shadow Report on Chapter 27 was prepared by the implementing partner civil society network Coalition 27, and published in October 2023. The Shadow Report is covering 8 thematic fields on over 180 pages, and it has reached 1500 individuals and 30 institutions. According to the received feedback it is used by European Commission - DG Env and DG NEAR, Serbian Ministry of Environmental Protection and Ministry of EU integration, Delegation of EU in Serbia etc, local governments, CSOs, media and businesses for planning, decision making and advocacy.
- The implementing partner civil society network Lets Afforest Vojvodina collected more than 14.600 signatures from over 30 municipalities, which eventually were submitted to the Provincial Government. As a result, the first massive planting of a windbreak was organized: 650 seedlings, 1 km long, planted with the participation of 90 volunteers (representatives of civil society, institutions and communities).
- Establishment of a dedicated budget line by the Local Self-Government in Kraljevo for the year 2024, amounting to €40,000. This budget allocation is specifically earmarked to support projects within the municipal volunteer firefighting sector. This development is a direct outcome of sustained dialogue and collaboration with key local stakeholders, coupled with the demonstrated capacity of the implementing partner Volunteer Firefighter Association (VFFA) in Kraljevo to effectively execute projects and extend the reach of volunteer firefighting organizations across the city's territory.
The programme was also very active in reaching the citizens to raise awareness and create more interest and demand for environmental improvements:
- YRS e-learning platform reached 10.656 people, where 102 new users have registered and attended one of the 14 free online courses. Educational video materials, as part of the courses viewed around 900 people.
- Campaign GOOD TREE implemented under umbrella of the ECO SYSTEM programme reached 400 pupils in primary schools from 13 places in Serbia, through educational workshops referring to biodiversity preservation and climate change mitigation measures.
- 360 young people from 15 places around Serbia took part in 8 environmental workshops, 3 trainings, 5 lectures, 3 volunteer camps and 7 volunteer actions.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
